name: @singularity/plugin-integrations-hooktheory
description: Hooktheory (TheoryTab) API client: next-chord trends and songs-by-progression (signed in), and one TheoryTab section's chords, melody, key, tempo and YouTube sync (public). Pure core readers turn a Hookpad document into a section and a chord into the notes it sounds (a port of Sheet Sage). Consumers never import @plugins/auth.
